scopeShell.scopeTree.title: Program scopes
scopeShell.scopeTree.description: Choose the operating perimeter to configure its knowledge, agents, access, channels, tests, and publication state.
scopeShell.workspace.description: Build this scope as a governed operating perimeter instead of managing deployment objects directly.
scopeShell.workspace.emptyDescription: A scope becomes the place where admins map workspaces, expected agents, collaborators, channels, tests, and publication actions.
scopeShell.knowledge.mapHint: Pick a workspace to attach its knowledge to this scope. The title defaults to the workspace name.
scopeShell.knowledge.noWorkspaces: No workspace found. Create or share a workspace first.
scopeShell.agents.empty: No expected agent is mapped to this scope yet.
scopeShell.agents.noAgents: No agent found. Create or share an agent first.
scopeShell.agents.search: Search agents by name or type
scopeShell.agents.selectionHelp: Select the agents that should answer public users for this scope.
scopeShell.access.inviteHint: Grant a user access to this scope, or to the whole program.
scopeShell.settings.title: Scope settings
scopeShell.settings.deleteConfirmBody: "{{name}}" and its knowledge, agents, channels, and deployment will be permanently removed. This cannot be undone.
scopeShell.channels.empty: No public channel is configured for this scope yet.
scopeShell.channels.noDeployment: Create a deployment to configure public channels for this scope.
scopeShell.channels.editHint: Enable the channels this scope should answer on, then save. A channel counts as ready once configured.
scopeShell.channels.allowedOriginsHint: Comma-separated domains allowed to embed the widget. At least one marks the widget ready.
scopeShell.channels.configured: Configuration exists. Real adapter validation will confirm publishability.
scopeShell.channels.configureInAdvanced: Not configured yet. Use advanced lifecycle tools until channel setup is promoted here.
scopeShell.testPublish.blockedHelp: Resolve the blockers in the readiness panel before publishing this scope.
scopeShell.testPublish.noDeployment: This scope has no deployment yet.
scopeShell.testPublish.noDraftRevision: This scope has no draft revision yet.
scopeShell.readiness.title: Next actions
scopeShell.readiness.noScope: Select a scope to see readiness blockers and warnings.
scopeShell.readiness.readyAction: No blocker remains for this scope.
scopeShell.advanced.title: Advanced access tools
scopeShell.advanced.description: Invite a collaborator by raw user ID, at the program level or scoped to one scope. Deployment, dry-run, and publish actions now live in the Test & Publish tab.
wizard.title: Create a scope
wizard.blueprint.title: Define the perimeter
wizard.blueprint.description: A scope is a governed operating perimeter. Give it a name and a type — you can configure the rest next.
wizard.knowledge.title: Map knowledge
wizard.knowledge.description: Select the workspaces that will feed this scope. Program-shared sources are inherited automatically.
wizard.agents.title: Map agents
wizard.agents.description: Which agents should answer for this scope? At least one is required before publishing.
wizard.channels.title: Configure channels
wizard.channels.description: Create a deployment so this scope can be tested and published. You can fine-tune channels later from the Channels tab.
wizard.publish.title: Test & publish
wizard.publish.description: This scope is set up. Finish to open its workspace — run a dry-run and publish from the Test & Publish tab whenever you're ready.
